# Yashashree Bhave

> Official website of Yashashree Bhave – Indian Idol Season 2 Finalist, Sa Re Ga Ma Pa Final Runner-up, and Bollywood playback singer.

## About
- Name: Yashashree Bhave (Yashi)
- Profession: Bollywood Playback Singer, Live Stage Performer, and Vocal Mentor
- Credentials: Indian Idol Season 2 Finalist (Sony Entertainment Television), Sa Re Ga Ma Pa Final Runner-up (Zee TV Alpha Marathi), 30+ years of stage experience, 3,500+ live concerts.
- Base Locations: Nagpur & Mumbai, Maharashtra, India.

## Key Services & Offerings
- Live Shows & Concert Bookings: Available for weddings, corporate galas, sangeet events, and musical nights (full orchestra or acoustic setup).
- Singing Classes: Professional vocal training online worldwide and offline in Nagpur (classical swaras, riyaz discipline, and playback techniques).
